description: This file implements network information handling for different platforms (Windows, POSIX, Apple). It includes classes and functions for network interface enumeration, IP address management, route handling, and network status updates, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to check status, enable/disable, set gateway, and update interface properties.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to MAC address, name, and index.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network adapter events and status changes.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton managing network interfaces and IP address configurations, platform-specific implementation for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with source, destination, gateway, interface, and other attributes.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information on Windows using GetAdaptersAddresses.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the number of network adapters.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string.

methods.name: Network::IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is up.

methods.name: Network::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is running.

methods.name: Network::Up
methods.description: Enables or disables the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Broadcast
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address for the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Gateway
methods.description: Sets the gateway for a network.

methods.name: Network::Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink messages.
